newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica says no change in BT swap.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica says no change in BT swap.

text.p: There has been no change in a deal between Telefonica and international alliance partner British Telecommunications to exchange shares for a value of 65 billion pesetas, a spokesman for the Spanish firm said on Thursday.
A report in Expansion daily on Thursday said the two had agreed to limit their share swap, with BT buying 1.5 percent of Telefonica rather than two percent as originally announced.
"The agreement has always been to exchange 65 billion pesetas in terms of shares," the spokesman said.
In the light of strong gains in Telefonica's share price since the deal was announced, this would mean fewer Telefonica shares at the current price.
Telefonica's share price has risen from 3,565 pesetas since close on the day the strategic alliance was announced on April 18. The shares closed on Wednesday at 4,430 pesetas.
